response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong distributed-systems and low-latency exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments and a small thesis project) and has no demonstrated production-level cloud compute platform leadership experience. His background is heavily web/product-focused (Node.js, TypeScript, Ember) rather than large-scale cloud infrastructure or compute/storage architecture at the depth this role demands.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/teaching experience (Refactoring Dojos, Selenium course, FOSS4G talk)
Solid distributed systems exposure at Dunnhumby (high-throughput microservices, low-latency async I/O)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (~6 months at National Instruments plus a student project), far short of the required 8 years
No clear track record of leading or architecting internal cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure at production scale
Career trajectory is broad/full-stack generalist rather than deep compute/infrastructure specialist, misaligned with the platform-leadership focus of this role

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong mentoring and technical leadership background
